# Boy Scouts: Tadpole's Theory Test Questions and Answers

![](/uploads/ajaxGallery_162_nukaknights-post-pfadfinder-theoriepruefung-kaulquappe-fragen-answers.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

To receive the normal **Backpack**, you must earn the rank "**Tadpole**" as a **Boy Scout**. To do this, you have to complete the Boy Scouts’ practical and theoretical exams. You can take the theory tests at the **Terminals** in both the **Camp Adams** and the **Boy Scout Pioneer Camp** (Camp Lewis). Since some of the exams are not entirely clear, we have a list of questions and appropriate answers for you here. 

If you have already passed the tadpole exams and are looking for the opossum answers, you can find them here: Pathfinder: Opossum Theory Exam Questions and Answers

![Boy Scouts: Camp Adams & Boy Scout Pioneer Camp (Camp Lewis)](/uploads/nukaknights-pfadfinder-lager-adams-lager-lewis-pfadfinderpionierlager.jpg) 

## Boy Scout Tadpoles Theory Test Areas:

*With this index you can jump directly to the appropriate areas. Under each area you will find a “back to top” link that will take you back to the index up here.*

##Archer:

Ultimately, only one person is responsible for your safety and the safety of others at the shooting range. Who is that?

**Answer**: Me

Alice is just about to take aim when she notices that her rival Annie is collecting her arrows in the lane next door. What should Alice do?

**Answer**: Lower the bow and slowly release the taut string

Lisa spends a lot of time doing archery and doesn't talk about anything else. What is the science of archery called?

**Answer**: Toxophilia

Communists have invaded! Alex is a master archer and wants to defend his country. Which arrowhead should he choose so that he can penetrate the thick armor of the communist pigs?

**Answer**: Bodkin lace

The ballista was developed thousands of years ago in the Greek city of Syracuse. This is basically an enlarged version of which weapon?

**Answer**: Crossbow

You're looking forward to your first archery trip at Camp Adams. But you still have to grab your arrows. What type of bag do they belong in?

**Answer**: Quiver

Bows and arrows have been used by humans for a very long time. According to scientists, when were the first bows and arrows developed?

**Answer**: 64,000 years ago

While hiking through the forest, you see your neighbor Jimmy randomly shooting arrows into the air. What should you do?

**Answer**: Take cover and demand that Jimmy put his bow down.

You enter a tournament and you still have one shot. You draw the bow, breathe calmly, aim and let go. The spectators cheer because you hit right in the middle! How many points do you get for this?

**Answer**:10

Your best friend Johnny's father donates his weekend making bows. You've been saving for months to buy a bow from Johnny's father because he's a...

**Answer**: Bowmaker

Robbie and his father plan a hunting trip to Seneca Rocks. They want to hunt white-tailed deer there with bows and arrows. What type of arrowheads should you pack?

**Answer**: Broadhead

Richie is at the shooting range and has shot all his arrows. What should he do next?

**Answer**: Wait until Mr. Handy gives the green light.

You craft a crossbow at a weapon workbench. Which component do you NOT need?

**Answer**: Compressor
